object.script:
function round(num, n) return math.floor(num * 10^n + 0.5) / 10^n end
function floor(n) return n >= 0 and n - n % 1 or n - n % 1 - 1 end
function onTick() cs=input.getNumber(1) speed = input.getNumber(2) alt = input.getNumber(3) bottom_dist = input.getNumber(4) axisX = input.getNumber(5) axisY = input.getNumber(6) dh = input.getNumber(7)
x=36+((-cs+0.5)*216)
speed_max_fwd = 15 speed_max_rev = -3 if speed >= 0 then if speed <= speed_max_fwd then speedY = 127 - (speed / speed_max_fwd) * (127 - 64) else speedY = 64 - ((speed - speed_max_fwd) / (20 - speed_max_fwd)) * (64 - 33) if speedY < 33 then speedY = 33 end end else if speed >= speed_max_rev then speedY = 127 - (speed / speed_max_rev) * (127 - 64) else speedY = 64 - ((speed - speed_max_rev) / (-20 - speed_max_rev)) * (64 - 33) if speedY < 33 then speedY = 33 end end end
y1 = 9 y2 = 14 if x <= 49 or x >= 240 then y1 = y1 - 2 y2 = y2 - 2 elseif (x <= 82 and x >= 47) or (x >= 207 and x <= 242) then y1 = y1 - 1 y2 = y2 - 1 end
if alt >= 0 then depth = 0.1 depthY = 33 else depth = -alt bottom_depth = depth + bottom_dist depthY = 33 + (depth / bottom_depth) * (127 - 33) if depthY > 127 then depthY = 127 end if depthY < 33 then depthY = 33 end end end
function onDraw() w=screen.getWidth() h=screen.getHeight() whf=w/2 hhf=h/2 s=screen dl=s.drawLine sc=s.setColor dt=s.drawText -- Compass line sc(0,127,255) dl(36,10,48,10) dl(48,11,81,11) dl(81,12,208,12) dl(208,11,241,11) dl(241,10,252,10) dl(36,11,48,11) dl(48,12,81,12) dl(81,13,208,13) dl(208,12,241,12) dl(241,11,252,11) dl(36,8,36,12) dl(252,8,252,12) sc(255, 0, 0) dl(x, y1, x, y2)
sc(255, 255, 255) dir = floor(cs * 360) % 360 dir_str = string.format("%d", dir) len = #dir_str
if len == 1 then textX = 144 - 2 elseif len == 2 then textX = 144 - 4 else textX = 144 - 6 end dt(textX+1, 2, dir_str)
--Speed sc(0,127,255) dl(10,32,10,128) dl(11,32,11,128) dl(10,32,14,32) dl(10,128,14,128) if speed >= 0 then sc(speed <= speed_max_fwd and 0 or 255, speed <= speed_max_fwd and 255 or 0, 0) else sc(speed >= speed_max_rev and 0 or 255, speed >= speed_max_rev and 255 or 0, 0) end dl(10, speedY, 14, speedY) dt(16, speedY-3, round(speed, 1)) sc(0,127,255) dt(5,24,"Speed")
--Alt sc(0,127,255) dl(278,32,278,128) dl(279,32,279,128) dl(279,32,275,32) dl(279,128,275,128)
if depth >= 100 then dt(225, 132, string.format("Bottom: %d", floor(bottom_dist+depth))) dt(245, 138, string.format("DH: %d", floor(-dh))) else dt(230, 132, string.format("Bottom: %d", floor(bottom_dist+depth))) dt(250, 138, string.format("DH: %d", floor(-dh))) end
if alt < 0 then sc(255, 0, 0) dl(276, depthY, 280, depthY) if depth >= 100 then dt(260, depthY-3, string.format("%d", floor(depth))) else dt(265, depthY-3, string.format("%d", floor(depth))) end end sc(0,127,255) dt(271,24,"Alt")
--ThrustIndicator local cx, cy = 144, 144 sc(40, 40, 40) dl(cx - 16, cy, cx + 16, cy) dl(cx, cy - 16, cx, cy + 16) local dx = axisY * 16 local dy = -axisX * 16 sc(0, 255, 255) dl(cx, cy, cx + dx, cy + dy) end
